summary: PvT Blink labels need Blink as the first Twilight upgrade, Shadow Stride no longer counts as Blink, and Charge openings with an early third Nexus get their own label.
PvT Oracle-first openings keep their Oracle label, the Oracle/Robo variant is labelled separately, and TvP Widow Mine Drop needs early mines with a Medivac-first Starport.
